_comment: Offline prayers matched to heart-states, used when no AI connection is available. Personalized AI prayers replace these when connected.
lonely: Lord, You see me here, far from everyone I love. On the days when the silence feels loud and no one asks how I am, remind me that You are near. Set my lonely heart in Your family. Send me a friend, and help me be a friend. Hold me tonight, Lord. Amen.
homesick: Father, You know how much I miss my family. Watch over them while I cannot — guard their health, their safety, their hearts. Let every sacrifice I make become a blessing for them. Shorten the distance with Your love, and bring the day of our reunion closer. Amen.
exhausted: Lord Jesus, You said, 'Come to me, all you who are weary, and I will give you rest.' I am weary. I have been strong for so long. Tonight I put down what I carry and rest in You. Renew my strength like the eagle's, and refresh my soul. Amen.
invisible: God who sees me — when I feel like only my work matters, remind me that You knew my name before I was born. My worth is not in what I do but in whose I am. Restore my dignity, lift my head, and let me see myself the way You see me. Amen.
anxious: Prince of Peace, my mind is full of what-ifs — about my work, my family, my future. I cast every anxiety on You because You care for me. Guard my heart and mind with Your peace that passes understanding. Help me trust You one day at a time. Amen.
heavy: Lord, You are close to the brokenhearted. My heart is heavy tonight, and I don't have all the words. You know what I carry even before I speak. Sit with me in this. Carry what I cannot. And in the morning, give me new mercy and new strength. Amen.
grateful: Thank You, Father, for Your goodness to me — for daily bread, for the people I love, for strength I didn't know I had. Every good gift comes from You. Keep my heart soft and thankful, even in hard seasons. Amen.
happy: Lord, thank You for this joy! You rejoice over me with singing, and today I rejoice with You. Let me share this happiness with someone who needs it, and let me never forget that every good day is a gift from Your hand. Amen.
neutral: Father, thank You for this ordinary day. In the routine and the quiet, You are still here. Great is Your faithfulness — Your mercies are new every morning. Walk with me through today, and let me notice Your small kindnesses along the way. Amen.
